messages.content: Quick intro since this is a fresh chat — I'm Jordan Rivera, a senior software engineer living in Austin, Texas.
Nice to meet you, Jordan. What's on your mind?
I just got back from a great hike at Barton Creek near my house here in Austin.
Barton Creek is beautiful! How was the trail?
Gorgeous. I grew up in Miami but I've been in Austin for about three years now—so much better for outdoor stuff.
Have you done much climbing here too?
Yeah, I go to the Austin Bouldering Project pretty regularly. Mochi, my greyhound, waits in the car—I rescued her about a year ago.
Had a long day at Meridian AI—we're in the middle of a big Go migration and it's a lot of work.
A Go migration sounds intense. Are you moving from another language?
Yeah, we were a Python shop but switched to Go for the backend about six months ago. It's faster but the ecosystem is different.
How long have you been at Meridian AI?
Two years. And actually I just got promoted to Senior Engineer a couple months ago, so that's exciting at least.
My brother Sam is visiting from Seattle this weekend. He's a PM at Google.
That sounds fun! Are you planning anything special?
Just showing him around. My parents are flying in from Miami too, so it'll be a full house—Elena and Carlos both love Austin.
Big family gathering!
Yeah. I'm also trying to squeeze in a call with my best friend Maya—she's in Denver working at Palantir. We met at PyCon 2021 in Salt Lake City actually.
I've been rewinding on Project Hail Mary while practicing guitar in the evenings.
Both at once? How long have you been playing?
About ten years, acoustic. Andy Weir is great but Ted Chiang is still my favorite—Story of Your Life is incredible.
What else do you have going on?
Trying to keep up my Spanish—I'm intermediate—and saving up for a Japan trip I'm planning for October.
Tacos al pastor for lunch today—the place near the office is the best I've had outside of Mexico City.
Sounds like a good lunch spot.
Totally. Also finally bit the bullet and got a Specialized Diverge for gravel riding—Austin has some great routes.
